traditions.KJV: and maintain their cause ,

traditions.KJV: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee ,

50.english_reference: and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ כָל פִּשְׁעֵי הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּשְׁעוּ בָ֑ ךְ

traditions.KJV: and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee ,

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַתָּ֧ ם לְ רַחֲמִ֛ים לִ פְנֵ֥י שֹׁבֵי הֶ֖ם
traditions.VUL: et dabis misericórdiam coram eis , qui eos captívos habúerint ,
traditions.KJV: and give them compassion before them who carried them captive ,

50.english_reference: that they may have compassion on them

traditions.WLC: וְ רִֽחֲמֽוּ ם

traditions.KJV: that they may have compassion on them :

51.english_reference: For they [ be ] thy people , and thine inheritance ,

traditions.KJV: For they [ be ] thy people , and thine inheritance ,

traditions.KJV: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל תְּחִנַּ֖ת עַמְּ ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל

traditions.KJV: and unto the supplication of thy people Israel ,

traditions.KJV: to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee .
